label.title: Label
label.description:
Label for the attribute, used for presentation in converted outputs
such as PDFs.

anyOf.title: Color
anyOf.description: Color of the item, either as a name or a code such as RAL or Pantone.

anyOf.title: Size
anyOf.description: Size of the item, such as a clothing size.

anyOf.title: Material
anyOf.description: Main material the item is made of, such as cotton or steel.

anyOf.title: Length
anyOf.description: Length of the item itself, excluding packaging, usually as an amount with a unit of measure.

anyOf.title: Width
anyOf.description: Width of the item itself, excluding packaging, usually as an amount with a unit of measure.

anyOf.title: Height
anyOf.description: Height of the item itself, excluding packaging, usually as an amount with a unit of measure.

anyOf.title: Diameter
anyOf.description: Diameter of the item itself, excluding packaging, usually as an amount with a unit of measure.

anyOf.title: Weight
anyOf.description: Weight of a single unit of the item itself, excluding packaging, usually as an amount with a unit of measure.

anyOf.title: Volume
anyOf.description: Volume of a single unit of the item itself, excluding packaging, usually as an amount with a unit of measure.

anyOf.title: Packaging Length
anyOf.description: Length of a single packaged unit of the item as shipped, usually as an amount with a unit of measure.

anyOf.title: Packaging Width
anyOf.description: Width of a single packaged unit of the item as shipped, usually as an amount with a unit of measure.

anyOf.title: Packaging Height
anyOf.description: Height of a single packaged unit of the item as shipped, usually as an amount with a unit of measure.

anyOf.title: Packaging Volume
anyOf.description: Volume of a single packaged unit of the item as shipped, usually as an amount with a unit of measure.

anyOf.title: Packaging Weight
anyOf.description: Gross weight of a single packaged unit of the item, including packaging, usually as an amount with a unit of measure.

anyOf.title: Production Date
anyOf.description: Date the item was produced or manufactured.

anyOf.title: Expiry Date
anyOf.description: Date the item expires or is best consumed before.

anyOf.title: Energy
anyOf.description: Energy content per 100g or 100ml, usually in kilojoules (kj) or kilocalories (kcal).

anyOf.title: Fat
anyOf.description: Total fat content per 100g or 100ml, usually in grams.

anyOf.title: Saturated Fat
anyOf.description: Saturated fat content per 100g or 100ml, usually in grams.

anyOf.title: Carbohydrates
anyOf.description: Carbohydrate content per 100g or 100ml, usually in grams.

anyOf.title: Sugars
anyOf.description: Sugar content per 100g or 100ml, usually in grams.

anyOf.title: Protein
anyOf.description: Protein content per 100g or 100ml, usually in grams.

anyOf.title: Salt
anyOf.description: Salt content per 100g or 100ml, usually in grams.

anyOf.title: Fibre
anyOf.description: Fibre content per 100g or 100ml, usually in grams.

anyOf.title: CO2e Emissions
anyOf.description: Greenhouse gas emissions of a single unit of the item expressed as a carbon dioxide equivalent, usually in kilograms.

key.title: Key
key.description:
Key that identifies the attribute, either from the list pre-defined by
GOBL or an alternative agreed upon between the supplier and customer.

type.title: Type
type.description:
Type defines a code used to identify the attribute when the "key"
field is empty, from a code list agreed upon between the supplier
and customer.

code.title: Code
code.description:
Code value of the attribute, used as an alternative to text when the
value comes from a code list agreed upon between the supplier and customer.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Amount used when the attribute represents a numeric or measurable value.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: Unit of measure that accompanies the amount.

org.Attribute.description: Attribute describes a named feature or property of the parent object, such as the color or size of an item.
